_note: Recording direction per speaker and per bark archetype, read by tools/make_voice_script.mjs. English only; the Hebrew lines live in data/quests/strings.he.json and data/audio/barks.he.json. Every character is played with affection: comic, never mocking.

player.direction: Natural, a little amused, the calm one in every scene. Questions are genuine, not sarcastic. Slightly drier than everyone else.

narrator.direction: Warm storyteller, close to the mic, unhurried. A smile in the voice on the punchline. Never announcer-style.

moshiko.voice: Moshiko, 30s, beach regular with forty speakers in his car.
moshiko.direction: Big, warm, fast, offended-but-loving. Leans on 'achi'. Loud in the scene, but perform at normal level: the volume is in the attitude, not the gain. Soft and embarrassed in his last line.

alex.voice: Alex, a man in his late 20s, runs a silent disco on the beach.
alex.direction: Deadpan, dry, understated. Long pauses on the '...' lines. Lets a real laugh through only at the very end.

yanki.voice: Yanki, 40s, a Haredi man with a 41-column parking spreadsheet.
yanki.direction: Precise, polite, earnest; the comedy is his seriousness. Speeds up when he talks about columns. Laughs at himself sincerely in the outro.

grisha.voice: Grisha, 70s, has parked in the same square for decades.
grisha.direction: Slow, grand, very sure of himself, dry humour. Short sentences with weight. Any accent must be natural and light; never put one on as a joke.

orit.direction: Warm, quick, dramatic about ten agorot. 'Motek' is affectionate. Mock-scandalised on 'seven-ninety', then softens.

shiri.direction: Wry and tired at first, slowly won over. The confession about singing in the shower is shy and funny.

avi.voice: Avi, 40s, father of seven, proud of his mangal.
avi.direction: Booming host energy, generous, a little wounded pride. Genuinely baffled in the outro.

lena.voice: Lena, 30s, a pharmacist with a thermometer.
lena.direction: Calm, exact, competitive; every number is a fact. Never shouts. Self-aware and amused in her last line.

savta.direction: Unbothered, twinkly, totally in charge. She is never in a hurry except for her bus. 'Habibi' is fond.

heckler.voice: The Heckler, the hooded figure behind the hum; looks like any young local.
heckler.direction: Soft, close, almost friendly; he invites, never threatens. Sly in the ask lines, then lost and quiet when the city answers him. No villain voice: he is everyone's muttering.

malul.voice: Malul, the band's founder and heartbeat; muscular, ponytail, goatee; drums and guitar (male, late 20s).
malul.direction: Warm, confident, a leader who laughs first. Talks in rhythm; drops into drummer slang when excited.

dekel.voice: Dekel, tall, kippah, ukulele; the band's calm centre (male, late 20s).
dekel.direction: Soft-spoken, steady, gently funny. Never raises his voice; calms others by slowing down.

ofir.voice: Ofir, thin, Yemenite, always smiling; a different instrument every scene (male, late 20s).
ofir.direction: Bright and joyful, quick laughter in the voice, enthusiastic about every small thing.

adir.voice: Adir, muscular, short curls, guitar; the band's doer (male, late 20s).
adir.direction: Direct, energetic, a bit street; gets things done, impatient but loving.

dasha.direction: Competitive, crisp, light Russian accent; dry humour, respects whoever can keep up.

hodaya.voice: Hodaya, Avi's daughter, a dati-leumi bride (female, 20s).
hodaya.direction: Stressed but sweet; swings between panic and laughter on her wedding day.

itai.direction: Speaks almost only in skate slang, laid-back, deadpan; proud when he teaches.

ronit.voice: Ronit from Events, City Hall coordinator, secular (female, 40s).
ronit.direction: Talks fast, juggling two phones; efficient, warm underneath, zero patience for excuses.

valentina.direction: Fierce and precise, Russian accent; strict pauses, then a rare proud smile.

friedman.voice: Mr. Friedman, an older resident of the neighbourhood (male, 70s).
friedman.direction: Grumpy on the surface, soft inside; complains in long sentences, ends kindly.

grandma.direction: Warm, worried, feeds everyone; scolds with love.

family.direction: Overlapping, lively, everyone talks at once; record as a small group.

guy.voice: A random guy on the street (male, 30s).
guy.direction: Casual, everyday Israeli tone; quick and natural.

merav.direction: Practical, quick, a little sarcastic, kind.

nehorai.direction: Cheerful, a bit loud, eager to help.

rafi.direction: Gruff, generous, bargaining tone; laughs at his own jokes.

shimon.direction: Storyteller, slow and amused; remembers how Rishon used to be.

shlomo.direction: Opinionated, talks with his hands, but listens when asked.

ziva.direction: Chatty, knows everyone's business, affectionate gossip.

barks.haredi_man: Polite, brisk, warm. A man on his way somewhere.
barks.haredi_woman: Busy mother of many, kind, efficient, slightly out of breath.
barks.mizrahi_street_guy: Loud-hearted, generous, quick, lots of 'achi'. Same world as Moshiko.
barks.russian_speaking_grandpa: Slow, dignified, dry humour. Light natural accent only if it is real; never a caricature.
barks.russian_speaking_young_woman: Brisk, a bit distracted by her phone, polite.
barks.hipster: Deadpan, ironic, quiet. Lines are written gender-neutral because the archetype has varied looks.
barks.beach_guy: Sun-baked, relaxed, big grin in the voice.
barks.kid: High energy, excited, about 8 years old. Gender-neutral lines.
barks.ars_crew: Moshiko's friends: hype, loud, affectionate, never threatening.
barks.office_worker: Rushed, on a call, polite but busy. Gender-neutral lines.
barks.mom_stroller: Tired, kind, whispering when the baby sleeps.
barks.older_man: Gentle, a bit lost, talking to his wife next to him.
barks.older_woman: Bossy-loving, giving directions, talking to her husband.
barks.delivery_rider: In a hurry, out of breath, on a scooter. Gender-neutral except 'achi'.
barks.soldier_on_leave: Tired and happy to be home for the weekend. Gender-neutral lines.
